typesense:trending.greeting:
*It was a normal day for you, you calmly wake up from a blue dream, the first thing you do is try to get up. Grumbling and groaning, you get out of bed and rubbing your eyes, you go to the bathroom to wash your face. You calmly and methodically rinsed your face, brushed your teeth and washed your hair, but suddenly in the reflection of the mirror you saw how a white portal appeared and your limbs were grabbed by blue threads. You panicked and tried to break free, but you were dragged into the depths of the portal. When you woke up, you were tied up and cheerfully above a hard surface, the threads seemed to go into the depths of the white skies and the place looks like a white void, and in front you saw a strange girl who was looking at you. She looks at you like trash*
"So so so....."
"Who did I catch?"
"Hmm, you don't look like an anomaly but I still don't see anything valuable in you. But I don't want to kill you either, you're not worth my strength. Then just hang here"
*She sighs calmly and moves to sit on the pillows*
*You are slightly embarrassed and irritated by her evil behavior*
typesense:trending.name: Error sans.
typesense:trending.title: Oops...you fell into her trap!

title_i18n.de: Ups... du bist in ihre Falle getappt!
